# String

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Strings](Language-Features-Strings)

</div>


```blitzbasic
String:String string:String, repeat:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | In | String | required | The text to repeat. |
| `repeat` | In | Int32 | required | How many copies to join. 0 gives an empty string. |

**Returns:** The repeated text.

## Description

Repeats a string several times.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print String$("ab", 3)
```

```text
ababab
```
